peers.name: NIVA BUPA HEALTH INS CO L

bull_bear.body: - The Ashwini.tech deployment was fully funded by AVI's zero-debt balance sheet plus a recent ₹89.99 Crore capital infusion, with no incremental leverage taken on.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- AVI Polymers is positioning itself at the intersection of AgriTech and HealthTech via a 'dual-engine AI strategy', pairing its already-live Agritech platform (KrishiBuddy) with the newly launched Ashwini.tech (AVI Health AI) HealthTech platform.
- Ashwini.tech, built by AVI's wholly-owned tech subsidiary, is pitched as a paradigm shift for India's mobile-first digital healthcare ecosystem.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Regulatory filing] Filed as an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, announcing the official launch of AVI Health AI and enclosing an investor presentation covering the platform's TAM and multi-channel revenue model (content not included in this extract).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: AVI Polymers positions itself as a dual-engine AI company, having just launched its HealthTech platform Ashwini.tech (AVI Health AI) alongside its existing Agritech platform, funded by a debt-free balance sheet and a fresh capital infusion, targeting commercialization in FY27.
